# vercel_alert_rule (Data Source)

Provides information about an existing Alert Rule.

Alert Rules decide which anomalies and custom Observability thresholds raise an alert for a team or a set of projects, and who is subscribed to the alerts that are raised.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vercel_alert_rule" "example" {
  id = "ar_xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the Alert Rule.

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team the Alert Rule exists under. Required when reading a team resource if a default team has not been set in the provider.

### Read-Only

- `alert_types` (Attributes List) The classes of alert this rule raises. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alert_types))
- `autosubscribe_owners` (Boolean) Whether team owners are automatically subscribed to alerts raised by this rule.
- `autosubscribe_project_admins` (Boolean) Whether project administrators are automatically subscribed to alerts raised by this rule.
- `custom_alert` (Attributes) The Observability query and trigger of a custom alert rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_alert))
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the team's Vercel-managed default Alert Rule.
- `name` (String) The human-readable name of the Alert Rule.
- `project_filter` (String) The OData expression limiting a built-in anomaly rule to specific projects. Null for team-wide rules and for custom alert rules.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project a custom alert rule monitors. Null for built-in anomaly rules.
- `sensitivity_level` (Number) How sensitive built-in anomaly detection is, from `1` (least sensitive) to `5` (most sensitive).

<a id="nestedatt--alert_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alert_types`

Read-Only:

- `filter` (String) The OData expression narrowing this alert type.
- `type` (String) The class of alert. Can be `usage_anomaly`, `error_anomaly`, or `custom_alert`.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_alert"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_alert`

Read-Only:

- `event` (String) The Observability event the query reads.
- `filter` (String) The OData expression limiting the whole query.
- `formula` (Attributes) Combines two rollups into a single value before the trigger is evaluated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_alert--formula))
- `granularity` (String) The window the query is bucketed into.
- `group_by` (List of String) The dimension the trigger is evaluated separately for.
- `min_threshold` (Number) The smallest observed value that can raise an alert.
- `rollups` (Attributes Map) The named measure aggregations the trigger is evaluated against. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_alert--rollups))
- `trigger_operator` (String) How the query result is compared against `trigger_threshold`.
- `trigger_threshold` (Number) The value the query result is compared against.
- `trigger_type` (String) How `trigger_threshold` is interpreted. Can be `threshold` or `anomaly`.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_alert--formula"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_alert.formula`

Read-Only:

- `left` (String) The name of the rollup used as the left-hand side of the formula.
- `operator` (String) How the rollups are combined.
- `right` (String) The name of the rollup used as the right-hand side of the formula.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_alert--rollups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_alert.rollups`

Read-Only:

- `aggregation` (String) How the measure is aggregated.
- `filter` (String) The OData expression limiting this rollup.
- `measure` (String) The measure that is aggregated.
